title: Compliant Outreach
tagline: How EvaWarm helped IDM Pharma achieve 89% inbox placement reaching healthcare professionals across NHS and private hospital domains — in a fully regulated environment.
about: IDM is a pharmaceutical company that uses email outreach to communicate with healthcare professionals (HCPs) — a highly regulated audience with strict compliance requirements under GDPR, HIPAA-adjacent guidelines, and industry codes of practice.
objective: Achieve strong inbox placement reaching NHS and private hospital email domains while satisfying medical-legal content approval requirements, GDPR compliance, and internal data-governance audit obligations.
challenges: HCP email addresses hosted on NHS and hospital domains apply aggressive content filtering for pharmaceutical terminology
Content required medical and legal review before sending, creating long approval cycles that limited copy iteration
DMARC policy was absent — authenticated and unauthenticated sends were indistinguishable to receiving servers
No audit trail for send-time metadata, blocking internal data-governance sign-off on the programme
Standard seed warmup networks are ineffective for NHS mail environments that operate outside major ISP reputation systems
Regulatory exposure: incorrect sender identity or unapproved content in a single send creates legal risk

solutions.title: Compliance-First Infrastructure
solutions.desc: Worked with legal and medical affairs upfront to define approved sender names, domain formats, and content guardrails — embedding compliance by design, not review.

solutions.title: Full Authentication at "Reject"
solutions.desc: Dedicated sending domains with strict SPF, DKIM, and DMARC at "reject" policy from day one — maximising trust with NHS servers that apply extra scrutiny to pharma senders.

solutions.title: Audit-Compliant Logging
solutions.desc: Integrated a logging layer recording full send-time metadata (recipient, timestamp, message hash) to an audit-compliant store, satisfying internal governance without impacting deliverability.

solutions.title: HCP-Domain Warmup
solutions.desc: Built warmup using IDM's own internal NHS and hospital contacts — generating domain-specific positive signals that standard seed networks cannot provide.

solutions.title: Conservative Volume Strategy
solutions.desc: Low, consistent volume rather than aggressive ramps — HCP domains reward reliability over time rather than raw engagement rates or rapid volume growth.

solutions.title: Custom Bounce Monitoring
solutions.desc: NHS mail servers return custom bounce codes requiring manual interpretation. We monitored and categorised every bounce to distinguish temporary blocks from permanent failures.

stats.label: Audit Submission
stats.sub: data governance review passed first time

takeaway: Compliance and deliverability are not in opposition. The discipline required to meet pharma's regulatory standards — consistent sender identity, documented processes, controlled volume — is also exactly what builds durable inbox trust.
conclusion: IDM Pharma's programme shows that even the most regulated outreach contexts can achieve strong inbox performance when compliance requirements are treated as engineering specifications rather than obstacles to work around.
